scope: Reported CPU derivations from already saved T2340 tensors, four train tasks and two teachers each; no new model/GPU/environment or parameter update. Raw tensors are not in the remote repository, so numbers are not independently reproducible from this package alone.

fixed_public_tangent.scope: Saved Q8 B-coordinate gradients only, arbitrary per-condition delta-Z tangent envelope; not actual Writer/Adam update or policy capacity. Zero new model/gradient/GPU.

learned_value_metric.scope: Fixed saved T2340 learned Z; O-only SGD induces delta M=-eta G Z^T Z. Does not represent all P/C/D learning, Adam or actual policy update. A28 actual ten-step consumers and independent B20 cotangents; comparison to saved key-only metric. Zero new model/GPU.

key_only_metric.scope: Fixed saved T2340 keys, exact arbitrary-Value linear map. Does not grant arbitrary V to the trained Writer or evaluate any policy. A28 actual 10-step consumers and separately independent B20 cotangents.

interpretation: With beta/A/native fixed, M_i=O Z_i and O-only SGD on shared conditions yields delta_M_j=-eta*sum_i w_i G_Ai Z_i^T Z_j. This is an exact fixed-Z O update identity, not the full Writer learning kernel or Adam.
The learned Value coordinates are more spectrally concentrated than the key-only transport. Low effective rank is not algebraic rank loss or evidence of missing task semantics.

Independent B gradients retain appreciable energy in weak learned-coordinate directions, particularly action_out, but their Rayleigh quotient exceeds the isotropic average in all 24 site-condition pairs. The evidence does not show a general inability to write useful directions.

All eight action_out O-only A50/B gradient cosines are negative; parameter reweighting is therefore not automatically a beneficial cross-episode correction. These are the old finite panels and cannot predict 64-step fresh Adam learning.

Fixing common B0 in the new diagnosis still permits 97.7078 percent of saved Q8 B-cotangent energy in a relaxed tangent envelope with arbitrary condition-specific delta_Z and a shared delta_O. This is not proof that the actual P/C/D Jacobian or optimizer reaches those directions.

Do not recommend widening, whitening, RLS or a new deployment path from this CPU calculation. Await the pre-registered S/P/D finite-learning and closed-loop results before assigning priority to generator restrictions.
